name: Orange Delicious
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: ¼ cup shredded candied orange peel
ingredients.originalText: ¼ cup shredded candied orange peel

instructions.text: Boil sugar and water eight minutes, then add orange juice
Scald cream, add yolks of eggs, and cook over hot water until mixture thickens
Cool, add to first mixture with heavy cream beaten stiff
Freeze; when nearly frozen, add orange peel
Line a melon mould with Orange Ice, fill with Orange Delicious, pack in salt and ice, and let stand one and one-half hours

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil sugar and water eight minutes, then add orange juice
2. Scald cream, add yolks of eggs, and cook over hot water until mixture thickens
3. Cool, add to first mixture with heavy cream beaten stiff
4. Freeze; when nearly frozen, add orange peel
5. Line a melon mould with Orange Ice, fill with Orange Delicious, pack in salt and ice, and let stand one and one-half hours
